topics.title: Apple launches research study and iPhone app to examine user trust in conversational health AI
topics.summary: On November 15, 2026, Apple launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study with clinical AI platform OpenEvidence. Open to up to 200,000 U.S. participants with Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhones running iOS 26, the virtual study tests how users engage with, understand, and trust medically grounded conversational AI.

topics.title: Japan's Defense Ministry plans updated military AI guidelines ensuring human accountability
topics.summary: On November 15, 2026, Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi announced in Yokosuka that the Ministry of Defense will release updated guidelines for defense-related AI at the end of November. The framework establishes three pillars: maintaining human accountability for decisions, leveraging defense data, and balancing adoption speed with security.

topics.title: Cohere acquires cybersecurity startup AISLE and code-review firm cubic for its sovereign AI platform
topics.summary: On November 13, 2026, Cohere announced it completed the acquisition of autonomous vulnerability-discovery startup AISLE and acquired AI code-review company cubic. AISLE forms a new Cohere Cyber unit led by co-founder Ondrej Vlcek, while cubic adds secure software development capabilities to Cohere's enterprise sovereign AI platform.
